findings.claim: The observable installation objective is not taught or checked end to end: the page assumes JDK and Maven binaries already exist at fictional paths and practises only PATH repair, while the module lab both claims this objective and requires JDK 25 and Maven as prerequisites. A learner who begins without the toolchain cannot complete the objective or enter the lab from these instructions.
findings.recommendation: Keep the frozen syllabus objective, but add an accessible real-machine installation path for each supported OS with numbered where-to-look, what-to-do, expected-output and completion-check steps, then verify java, javac and mvn before the lab. Alternatively, stop claiming the module lab covers o1 and add a separate authentic setup check that does.
